The most legendary field jacket of all time, the M-65 is here to play! We're tracing the M-41, the M-43, the M-51, and the M-65 through the rabbit holes of history and skipping across the ponds of utilitarianism, or something along those lines. I'm nervous you think I wrote that with AI. Isn't it so weird that that is now a possibility now? In college we used to have to debate about if AI will come for peoples jobs or not. So odd. ANYWAY -- The M-65 is NOT AI (I don't think). It's one of the greatest field jackets that has ever been made. Period. End of discussion. Good day. I SAID GOOD DAY.
